name: manual.intact_camp_shakedown_mcw
description: Manual playtest handoff: intact McWilliams camp with armed camp NPCs and nearby active bandit shakedown pressure staged. The harness only loads the save and audits footing; it sends no gameplay keys after load.

steps.label: post_load_manual_intact_camp_settle
steps.expected_visible_fact: manual handoff loads onto the intact camp map before the tester advances time or chooses any branch

steps.label: audit_manual_intact_camp_armed_npcs
steps.abort_reason: saved NPC metadata did not prove armed camp followers plus a nearby hostile raider for manual shakedown play

steps.label: audit_manual_intact_camp_bandit_pressure
steps.abort_reason: saved bandit_live_world state did not prove one nearby hostile raider active for the manual shakedown scene

manual_playtest.question: Does an intact armed camp make the shakedown and Fight branch feel like a believable camp-defense scene?
tester_notes: Advance time or move naturally until the bandit demand appears.
Try Pay once if you want to inspect the real trade surface, or choose Fight and watch whether camp NPCs commit sensibly.
Save after the outcome if you want metadata comparison on survivors and active bandit state.
metadata_to_check_after: saved bandit_live_world active group and site state

evidence_contract.claim: manual load starts from current staged intact-camp shakedown footing without harness gameplay input
evidence_contract.load_only_verdict: manual handoff footing only; gameplay feel comes from tester play after handoff
